chat.completions.notes: Parameter name is model-specific. o-series / Terra reject max_tokens. Legacy chat models still use max_tokens in this adapter.

responses.notes: Not the production endpoint. AIRequest.max_output_tokens must not be forwarded here from OpenAIEngine.

gpt-5.6-terra.evidence: 4B.2.5 HTTP 400 invalid_request_error unsupported_parameter max_tokens. Server message: Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead. A successful Terra response with max_completion_tokens has not been observed; acceptance remains UNKNOWN.

unlisted_openai_chat_completions_default.evidence: Unlisted OpenAI chat.completions model. Adapter keeps the legacy max_tokens field used by existing local OpenAI tests. This is not a claim that every future model accepts max_tokens.
